At a share of around 9% , the water sector is one of Jordan's largest single consumers of electricity, and the trend is rising. The energy cost is considered one of the big challenges as it is made up around half of the operation and maintenance cost of water and wastewater services in the sector . High rates of drinking water loss (over 50%), which can be traced back to combination of illegal use and connections on supply networks, vandalism and leakage , increase the pressure on water resources and significantly reduce the economic efficiency of the Jordanian water sector. Not forgetting the effects of climate change will significantly reduce the available water resources over the next 20 years (15% by 2040).
